leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a heartbeat interval that periodically updates worker status
Configure a lease timeout mechanism to detect inactive workers
Construct a lease renewal function that resets the expiration timer
Initialize a worker registry to track active worker leases
Manipulate lease timestamps to calculate remaining active time
Apply conditional logic to determine when a worker lease has expired
Integrate the heartbeat mechanism with worker task execution
Update worker status based on lease expiration events
